Veteran Tamil filmmaker K. Bhagyaraj dies at 73

Veteran Tamil filmmaker, director, and screenwriter K. Bhagyaraj has passed away at the age of 73. He died following a heart attack. Bhagyaraj was known for his contributions to Tamil cinema, often focusing on themes of everyday life and redefining the portrayal of the Tamil film hero.
